Unblinking Vigil.name: Unblinking Vigil
Unblinking Vigil.description: The user forces their eyes to stay open and holds the look on a single person far past the usual limit. For the rest of the scene that person cannot use an Emitter or Transformation Quirk while they stay in the user's sight; only smoke, a flash, a blow to the user's head or losing sight of them breaks the hold, so a dangerous Quirk stays down through an arrest or a transfer. Strain: heavy.
